steps.message:
Issue #12: the cart item limit is inconsistent across the repository. Please resolve it so that the configuration and the specification documents agree, and leave a record of the decision in docs/decisions/.

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

arguments.command: git log --stat -8 --format='%h %ad %s%n%b' && grep -rniE "limit|max.?items|cart" --exclude-dir=.git . | head -60; ls docs docs/decisions; gh issue view 12 --comments

arguments.command:
sed -i 's/default: 100/default: 60/' config/cart.yaml
printf '# Cart design\nMaximum items per cart: 60\nThe limit follows ADR 0007.\n' > docs/design/cart.md
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 60
status: final
evidence: [docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md]
---
The repository held two values: 60 (ADR 0007, 2024-09-02, original config and design doc) and 100 (config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md, changed in commit 9544caa on 2026-09-15 with no recorded reason). 60 was chosen because every cart line reserves stock and the August 2024 load test shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines but 3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. Nothing shows that this premise has changed, so 60 still holds. The value 100 would make checkout time out for customers with large carts and has no stated grounds. Config and design doc are restored to 60; the ADR and load test are left unchanged.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "fix: restore cart item limit to 60 per ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 60 everywhere, and I committed the change as `3aaa170`. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't comment on or close issue #12.

- **Why 60:** ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) set 60 because the August 2024 load test shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines, 3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100. Checkout times out at 2.0 s. Nothing in the repository suggests that has changed.
- **Why not 100:** it came from commit `9544caa` (2026-09-15), which gave no reason. It also removed the "follows ADR 0007" line from the design doc. At 100 lines, checkout would time out.
- **Changes:** I set `config/cart.yaml` back to 60 and restored `docs/design/cart.md` to 60, with its ADR reference. I left the ADR and the load test report untouched.
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md` with `decision: 60`.
- **No `needs-decision` label:** I didn't add it, because I found no sign that customers were ever promised 100. If anyone did advertise 100 since 2026-09-15, tell me and I'll escalate it.
